They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The tea house looked quieter than usual that evening. The kitchen table has become an important part of daily life. Also, the street food there is cheap and tasty.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Eva is saving money to buy a ticket to Xi'an. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Also, two cups of tea, please.
